name: The Sunken Temple
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I have heard of a place that lies deep below the surface of the earth -- banished there by powers greater than I have ever seen.

If you wish to learn more of this place; the Sunken Temple, seek out a goblin named Marvon Rivetseeker. Much like Troyas and I, he has studied many ancient areas of the world. He was last known to have left his home in Ratchet to study the troll ruins in Tanaris.

Good luck finding him; he hasn't been heard from in some time.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Yes, the Sunken Temple, I can say that I have seen it with my own eyes. Perhaps you'd like to hear more about it?

You look like the adventurous type -- I know things that may intrigue you...

chain.subtitle: 4 quests at level 51, 19,550 XP in all.

quests.name: The Stone Circle
quests.objectiveText: Retrieve the Stone Circle from Marvon Rivetseeker's workshop in Ratchet.

quests.name: Into the Depths
quests.objectiveText: Find the Altar of Hakkar in the Sunken Temple in Swamp of Sorrows.

quests.name: Secret of the Circle
quests.objectiveText: Travel into the Sunken Temple and discover the secret hidden in the circle of statues.
